t: 权律将军率领约 3,000 名朝鲜守军，在幸州之围中成功击退 30,000 多名日军。
te: Approximately 3,000 Joseon defenders led by general Kwŏn Yul successfully repel more than 30,000 Japanese forces in the…
dz: 日本入侵朝鲜：权律将军率领约 3,000 名朝鲜守军，在幸州之围中成功击退 30,000 多名日军。
de: Japanese invasion of Korea: Approximately 3,000 Joseon defenders led by general Kwŏn Yul successfully repel more than 30,000 Japanese forces in the Siege of Haengju.

de: Battle of Sisak: Allied Christian troops defeat the Ottomans.
